This looks like a CBP ruling on GFRP closet rods. The candidate headings are:

- 3926.90 (other articles of plastics) – 3926.90.9990 is the usual "other" line.
- 3925 (builders' ware of plastics) – 3925.90 covers other builders' ware, but a closet rod is not clearly builders' ware.
- 3916 (monofilament and rods) – this heading covers unworked rods and profile shapes, merely surface-worked. A painted, cut-to-length hollow rod is a tube/profile, so it could fit 3917, but a closet rod is a finished article.
- 9403.90 (furniture parts) – closet rods might be considered furniture parts, but 9403 furniture is not clearly the right fit.

I recall CBP rulings on fiberglass closet rods, e.g., NY N301911, which classified them in 3926.90.9990 (other articles of plastics). Rather than 3925.90, the ruling treats a closet rod as a household article under 3926.90. I'll go with 3926.90.9990 (the current statistical suffix is 3926.90.9990 "Other").
